text:
alejandro: Hey support — accepted org invite via Okta SSO and now most console buttons are greyed out. Projects/Settings show 'You don't have access' and API calls return 403. Screenshot: https://inbox.acme/shot.png
marie: Sorry about that — can you confirm the org name + email you used to accept? Any recent group renames in Okta?
louis: Also paste the exact 403 body from the API if you can (curl or browser devtools).
alejandro: Org=acme-fin, email=alejandro@acme.com. API error from GET /v1/projects -> 403 {"error":"permission denied", "code":"403"}. Console shows buttons but disabled. No recent renames on our side.
sara: We had a similar report last month where idp group claims were truncated/normalized and the org_admin mapping was lost. Quick check: can you open browser devtools > Network > the /auth/session call and paste the id_token / user claims object?
alejandro: Pasted token claims (redacted): {"email":"alejandro@acme.com","groups":["Engineering","Product","GH-sso:acme-org-admin"],"roles":[]} — group looks present but roles empty.
louis: That group name has a colon. Our old SCIM/claim transform sometimes strips or normalizes characters after colons, so the backend role mapping can miss it. Could be a mapping mismatch.
amit: If that's the case we can do a forced resync to update the internal group -> role mapping. We need the Okta user id (not just email) to run safely.
marie: @alejandro please provide Okta user id (or paste the Okta profile URL) and confirm you can do a quick logout/login after we run a fix.
alejandro: Okta user id: 00u1a2b3c4. I can test logout/login.
sara: Thanks. I'll try a manual mapping as a temporary workaround and push a mapping rule to staging. Manual command we run internally: `tools/user-map --okta-id 00u1a2b3c4 --add-role org_admin`
system-bot: ran `tools/user-map` for 00u1a2b3c4 -> added role org_admin (job id: resync-5882).
louis: After we applied mapping, clear sessions and re-login. That usually surfaces the new permissions.
alejandro: Just logged out and back in — buttons are back, can access project settings. Thank you.
sara: We'll deploy the mapping rule change to prod and add an integration test to catch colon-containing group names. Opening ticket SID-4892 to track permanent fix and an alert for idp claim/role mismatches.
marie: Marking this thread resolved for support. If you see recurrence after the next Okta sync, reopen the ticket and ping eng-sso. :white_check_mark: 
alejandro: Appreciate the fast help — leaving here in case anyone needs the repro steps: 1) Invite via Okta SSO 2) Accept 3) Observe 403 on project endpoints 4) Check id token groups shows expected group but roles missing
sara: notes for engineers — likely root cause: claim normalization on our SCIM transformer + special chars in group names. Proposed long-term: update transformer to preserve identifier suffix after colon OR canonicalize mapping rules; add diagnostic header `X-IdP-Claim-Check` on invite flow.
amit: I'll add the diagnostic and add a smoke test in staging for group names with punctuation. ETA 48h.
marie: Closing support loop. If anyone needs logs/timestamps let me know and I'll attach resync job output.
